narratives.title: Geopolitical Escalation Risk-Off
narratives.summary: Capital is fleeing risk assets as multi-front conflicts (US-Iran, Israel-Lebanon, Ukraine-Russia) escalate beyond controlled tit-for-tat. The Apache shootdown, Hormuz blockade persistence, and Iran's retaliation falsify 'one-and-done' narratives, driving safe-haven flows.
narratives.trade_implication: Long VIX, short SPY, long gold and USD; underweight EM equities and oil-sensitive currencies.

narratives.title: Oil Supply Disruption Premium
narratives.summary: Capital is pricing a structural oil supply shock from the Hormuz blockade persisting through Q3 2026, with Kuwait seeking bypass pipelines and EIA raising WTI forecasts. The SPR release is misread as bearish but actually signals government preparation for sustained disruption.
narratives.trade_implication: Long WTI futures and energy equities; short refined product spreads; consider long-dated oil call options.

narratives.title: Diplomatic Off-Ramp vs. Reality
narratives.summary: Capital is caught between White House claims of 'progress' on Iran deals and on-ground escalation (IDF readiness, Tyre evacuation). This uncertainty creates whipsaw risk in oil and equities as markets oscillate between hope and fear.
narratives.trade_implication: Neutral duration in Treasuries; long volatility via straddles on WTI and SPX; avoid directional bets until clarity emerges.
